purpose: Challenge the selected binary price-update clock-dispersion mechanism against nearby frozen families before any Campaign055 value is computed.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_price_update_clock_entropy_10b_238m
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: Broad clock-time dispersion of binary close updates across both continuous-auction halves represents sustained price discovery rather than isolated bursts.
selected_mechanism.formula: On the fixed 240-close grid, create 119 within-half adjacent comparisons in each half, mark exact close inequality, count events in five fixed bins per half using floor(5*k/119), and return ten-bin Shannon entropy divided by ln(10), requiring at least 20 events.

overlap_challenges.reason: Update share counts how many transitions changed. Campaign055 conditions on at least twenty events and measures only their ten-bin clock allocation; identical update counts can have entropy near zero or one.

Campaign051 bins completed-session close levels by price range. Campaign055 bins binary update-event incidence by clock time, discards price levels after equality tests, and does not use the completed-session range.
Those mechanisms use return sign, magnitude, ordering, or distribution. Campaign055 retains only equality versus inequality and ignores sign, magnitude, and within-bin event order.
Those families locate traded amount or volume in clock time. Campaign055 reads neither amount nor volume and gives every binary close-update event unit weight.
Campaign053 aligns amount mass with absolute-return mass at 238 endpoints. Campaign055 has no amount or return magnitude and summarizes only fixed-bin incidence of nonzero close changes.

Campaign054 sorts volume-weighted transaction-price levels and ignores clock order. Campaign055 reads close only, uses no transaction price or weight, and measures clock dispersion of equality changes.

Candidate49 counts ordered crossings around a causal cumulative VWAP and requires volume. Campaign055 constructs no anchor or crossing, reads no volume, and remains historical-only without Candidate49 backfill.
Campaign055 contains one raw close-event statistic and no terminal factor value, fitted weight, regime, filter, threshold, subset, combination, or model.

decision.next_action: Freeze one exact 78-comparison coverage-first no-return protocol, with one conditional development trial only if admitted, before implementing or reading Campaign055 values.
